title: Pre-push HQ_CI_ONLY and keychain tests: closing the #4753 gaps
description: The tests for the pre-push HQ_CI_ONLY=1 skip and the headless Chrome keychain guard passed even when the hook or guard was wrong. New arms pin the security stage, HQ_CI_ONLY=0 and empty, and targeted mode; the guard now catches four launch shapes it missed; a failed git grep no longer reads as a pass.
